cards.title: Playback bugs (reproduced)
items: Reaching the end of the text crashes the play loop (IndexError); the final stop broadcast is lost, so the dashboard still shows playing
Start after the end crashes again and leaves is_playing true; Start then does nothing until Pause is pressed
Next past the last character returns HTTP 500 (IndexError)
Next / Previous / Repeat send the ON pattern and never turn it off; motors vibrate until the next command
Pause then Start within ~1.6s leaves two play loops running at once
Next / Previous during playback move the same indices the loop is using

cards.title: Capture path
items: The trigger only returns after the whole pipeline: OCR + summary over 10s shows "Could not reach the ESP32-CAM", yet the capture still finishes and is broadcast
OCR + summary can take up to 40s; the camera gives up at 20s and logs a failed upload, but the backend still processes it
Camera init failure does not stop boot; every capture then fails with 500, shown as "Could not reach the ESP32-CAM"
The camera web server handles one request at a time; a second trigger waits for the first upload
An empty POST /api/capture still goes to Gemini and ends as "no readable text"
Capturing during playback swaps the text mid-play; the loop keeps running from the new start

cards.title: Gemini fail-soft
items: OCR non-200, timeout or unexpected response shape → empty text → "Capture returned no readable text."
Empty OCR text skips the summary call
Summary failure → the raw OCR text is played instead
Empty text → Start sends one all-off cell and stops cleanly

cards.title: Text → Braille
items: Only a–z are mapped; digits and punctuation are removed before playback
Apostrophes are kept and play as a blank (all-off) cell for 1.2s
Uppercase is lowered; sentences split only on . ! ? followed by whitespace
WORD_PAUSE is defined in config.py but never used: no extra gap between words
Previous jumps to the first letter of the previous word and never crosses into the previous sentence
Pause takes effect after the current on + off cycle (up to 1.6s) and still advances one character

cards.title: Motor board
items: Unreachable board: each command is logged and playback continues, but each try can add up to 1.5s per cell
The backend ignores the reply status, so 400 "missing body" / "bad json" pass silently
Motors are set before audio; WAV playback holds the reply, so long clips exceed 1.5s and are logged as unreachable
Missing WAV or failed LittleFS mount is logged on serial; motors still work
The session never passes speak_char, so the speaker is silent during playback

cards.title: Network + dashboard
items: Both boards retry Wi-Fi forever at boot with no timeout
The two firmwares are set to different Wi-Fi networks and config.py IPs sit on different subnets; the laptop must reach both
Device IPs are DHCP-assigned; stale IPs in config.py only show as "Could not reach" logs
The camera's upload URL hardcodes the laptop IP in camera.ino
Dashboard reconnects every 2s and gets the full state on connect; dead sockets are dropped on the next failed send
Any broadcast during a pending capture (e.g. a playback tick) is treated as the capture result
